category_title: Third-grade students with E/BD exhibiting externalizing disruptive behaviors during reading
scenario_title: Disruptive externalizing behaviors during reading instruction and group work
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small group reading activity in a third-grade classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, let's open our books and take turns reading the first paragraph for our group work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs loudly) Hey, who wants to talk about the new video game instead of this?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get back to the reading assignment, please.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whining) I don't want to read right now. I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to participate with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not doing this stupid work! (Starts talking loudly to another student while the teacher is talking) Hey, ignore them, let's talk about the game!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, let's open our books and take turns reading the first paragraph for our group work.

STUDENT: (Laughs loudly) Hey, who wants to talk about the new video game instead of this?

TUTOR: Let's get back to the reading assignment, please.

STUDENT: (Whining) I don't want to read right now. I'm not doing it.

TUTOR: You need to participate with your group.

STUDENT: I said I'm not doing this stupid work! (Starts talking loudly to another student while the teacher is talking) Hey, ignore them, let's talk about the game!

context.social_setting: Group work with peers and teacher instruction
context.time_context: 15 min 4 days per week during reading instruction

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Talking in class while the teacher is talking, nonacademic talk with peers during group work, making noises (i.e., laughing, whining) during instruction, verbally refusing to do work, and using inappropriate language

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Engage in externalizing behavior patterns, display high rates of disruptive behavior
